Theorem 15.30
Let psi : X -> R differentiable in int X, closed, and strictly convex.
Let V subseteq X be a non-empty closed convex set.
Assume x_t in int X
ell_t subdifferentiable on V
and eta_(t+1) <= eta_t, for t = 1, ..., T.
Then, for all u in V, Algorithm 15.8 satisfies
sum ell_t(x_t) - sum ell_t(u) <= max_(0<=t<=T-1) B_psi(u;x_t)/eta_T - sum (1/eta_t) B_psi(x_t;x_(t-1))
Moreover, if eta_t is constant, i.e., eta_t = eta for all t = 1, ..., T
sum (ell_t(x_t)-ell_t(u)) <= B_psi(u;x_0)/eta - (1/eta) sum B_psi(x_t;x_(t-1))
Proof: From the first-order optimality condition of Theorem 2.8 on the update ... there exists g_t in partial ell_t(x_t) such that
<eta_t g_t + grad psi(x_t) - grad psi(x_(t-1)), u-x_t> >= 0, for all u in V
Hence, we have
eta_t(ell_t(x_t)-ell_t(u)) <= <eta_t g_t,x_t-u>
<= <grad psi(x_(t-1)) - grad psi(x_t), x_t-u>
= B_psi(u;x_(t-1)) - B_psi(u;x_t) - B_psi(x_t;x_(t-1))
